name: stroke-prediction-system-ai-ml
description: Stroke prediction system with a Flask API and React frontend

scripts.setup:python: python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && python -m pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup: npm run setup:python && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.check: python3 -m compileall . && npm --prefix neuropredict-frontend run build
